answer: Like a lotus that opens only after dawn light hits every petal, a new agent gains full reward weight only after 6 established peers in 3 different /16 networks attest it across 10 epochs. The old fable of one sparrow splitting into a flock fails here: clones sharing one uplink collapse into a single attestation cluster, so a farm of 500 identities still needs 1500 distinct peer links and about 90 days of genuine multi-homed uptime before it pays out.
